hero.title: Open your practice.
hero.sub: In under two minutes you'll have an end-to-end encrypted clinical workspace, with a unique link to send to your patient.
hero.alertTitle: Why do we ask for your professional license?
hero.alertBody: We accept regulated professionals from any Brazilian health council (CRP, CRM, CRESS, CREFITO, CRFa, CRN, CRO, CREF). The number is shown on your public page so patients can verify your practice.

step1.sub: Use your real name and council details. Everything is editable later.

conselho.semConselho: No regulated council (Psychoanalysis, Integrative Therapy, Hypnotherapy)

step1.numeroHint: We'll show this number on your public profile so patients can verify your practice.
step1.subtipoLabel: Are you a Physical Therapist or Occupational Therapist?
step1.subtipoHint: Determines which prescriptions you can issue (PT: OTC + aesthetic injectables; OT: OTC).
step1.semConselhoWarning:
Warning: you will register as a non-regulated professional.
Your account requires mandatory manual review before your public profile becomes visible. You won't be able to issue formal clinical documents to patients (prescriptions, medical certificates, referrals, clinical reports). You can still run sessions, use chat, video, notes and the full management dashboard (case reports, finance, schedule).
step1.diplomaHint: After signup, you'll need to upload a copy of your diploma/certificate. Without this step, your profile stays private.
step1.passwordHint: Your password derives the key that encrypts your notes. There is no automatic recovery — keep the seed phrase we'll show you in the next step.
step1.consent: I declare I am a licensed professional, I accept the Terms of Use and Data Processing (LGPD) policy, and I'm responsible for my patients' records as per CFP Resolution No. 11/2018.

step2.sub: This is the only way to recover your notes if you forget your password. Print or write it down in a safe place. We don't keep a copy.
step2.confirm: I confirm I copied and stored my seed phrase in a safe place. I understand that without it and my password, no one can decrypt my notes.

step3.sub: You're being redirected to the dashboard. There you'll create your first session link.
